name: wardens_of_the_cycle_resolves_after_it_leaves
note: Wardens of the Cycle: 'Morbid -- At the beginning of your end step, if a creature died this turn, choose one -- * You gain 2 life. ...' The opponent's Bear died, so the ability triggers at P0's end step (P0 chooses the first mode); with it on the stack, Wardens is returned to P0's hand. The intervening 'if' is checked again on resolution (CR 603.4) and is about any creature, not Wardens: it is still true, so P0 gains 2 (22) though Wardens is gone.
